sections.content: Custom properties (--name) store reusable values: colors, spacing, fonts. Change once at :root, update everywhere via var(--name).
They enable theming (dark mode = swap variables) and runtime updates from JavaScript. Unlike preprocessor vars, they are live in the browser.
Key points: define on :root for global scope, fallbacks via var(--x, red), and they inherit down the DOM tree.
